name: Hive 1.5.9 — security audit
notes: A cross-repo security + reliability pass. Highlights: closes two critical workspace-takeover paths (a forged unsigned-but-stamped event is now quarantined; a contested account-key binding now fails closed instead of a first-wins hijack); per-device revocation; passphrase keys hardened to Argon2id; the P2P path now runs the full identity gate; and the signing preimage is injective/fail-closed. Reliability: agent turns now time out on IDLE (no output) rather than a wall-clock cap, so a long working turn is no longer killed at 600s; Stop aborts every turn path; a stuck-'thinking' watchdog; and progressive Markdown while streaming. Plus a CSP on the webview, a dependency-vuln CI gate, and many app/frontend fixes. See the release for the full list.
